name: pygfxd
notes: Python ctypes bindings for libgfxd (N64 F3D/F3DEX2 display-list disassembler). Built from the git clone at commit fd11c99 (no release tags; last upstream push 2024-01-13). Upstream Makefile fails to link on macOS (GNU -Wl,--whole-archive flags); libgfxd.so was linked manually with -Wl,-all_load. Smoke test passes on a hand-made two-command display list.
